name: two_shaft_gas_turbine_expander_map
title: Two-shaft gas turbine from compressor and expander data
summary: Steady exercise of a two-shaft gas turbine on air burning methane: a gas-generator shaft (compressor, adiabatic combustor, turbine 1 closed by a mechanical efficiency of 0.98) and a power turbine on a second shaft at the fixed reduced mass flow 188. The compressor reduced flow and isentropic efficiency are interpolated from a map versus the pressure ratio; the expander reduced flow and isentropic efficiency from a second map versus its pressure ratio; the products use the mean specific heats of the ULiège combustion library.
language_features: INTERPOLATE (native EES keyword form with a named argument)
user-library routines cpbar and gamma (implicit library, copied in from CSL-0005)
property functions (Air, CH4 and ideal-gas species)

origin.course: MECA0006 Machines et systèmes thermiques (ULiège), repetition R9, exercise 3

verification.summary: Stored solution of MSTH-SB-R9-EX3.EES (EES X7.458). compare_solution.py: 41 common variables, 5 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 0; only in CoolSolve: 8 unused cpbar outputs. Largest deviations are the cp(CH4)-driven q_2 (1.16e-2) and cp_g (1.08e-2); all other variables within 1.91e-3.
verification.reference: EES stored solution of MSTH-SB-R9-EX3.EES (41 numeric values of 42 names, EES X7.458), compared with tools/compare_solution.py
verification.notes: q_2 and cp_g share the cp(CH4) difference between EES and CoolProp (~1 %, same as CSL-0220); cp_a and the dependent T_2 and T_2_s differ by at most 1.91e-3 (CoolProp air). Flows, works, pressures, map reads, f and eta_m agree within 1e-3. The 8 CoolSolve-only names are unused outputs of the two cpbar CALLs. The .initials file (EES stored solution) is required: without it the 37-variable block does not converge.
